historical_occurrences.synopsis: David Steele began New Year's Eve morning at home with his family.
historical_occurrences.story: Beginning around 6:00 AM CST on December 31, 2025, David Steele woke at home, spent the morning with Anna, Hannah, and Junior, and ate breakfast with his family. They discussed their plans for the New Year's Eve party before David left for work. The source timeline spans approximately 6:00-8:15 AM.

historical_occurrences.synopsis: David Steele commuted through Riverside to Norfolk Tower.
historical_occurrences.story: At approximately 8:15 AM CST on December 31, 2025, David Steele left his morning routine behind and commuted through Riverside toward Norfolk Tower for work. The source timeline spans approximately 8:15-9:00 AM.

historical_occurrences.synopsis: Mr. Nelson accused David Steele of embezzlement and fired him.
historical_occurrences.story: Beginning around 9:00 AM CST on December 31, 2025, Mr. Nelson confronted David Steele at Norfolk Tower with records accusing David of embezzlement. David disputed the records and produced a backup thumb drive containing what he believed were the correct books. Nelson fired David. David retained the thumb drive, packed his belongings, was escorted out, and left the office. The source timeline places his office departure between approximately 9:00 and 10:00 AM.

historical_occurrences.synopsis: James Poole worked the New Year's Eve morning shift at Morning Brew.
historical_occurrences.story: Beginning around 6:00 AM CST on December 31, 2025, James Poole worked his morning shift at Morning Brew as the rush faded. He served regular customer Elena Reynolds while Nina Weaver worked nearby. The source timeline spans James's shift approximately 6:00 AM-noon.

historical_occurrences.synopsis: Tamara Wright visited James Poole and they spoke about Jordan's death.
historical_occurrences.story: At approximately 9:00 AM CST on December 31, 2025, Tamara Wright visited James Poole at Morning Brew. She was visibly grieving her brother Jordan, who had been killed by police. James and Tamara spoke outside about Jordan before shifting the conversation to the New Year's Eve party. Tamara encouraged James to attend and he agreed. The source timeline places Tamara's visit at approximately 9:00-9:30 AM.
